lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits. The spots are arranged in a roughly staggered grid, with diameter size decreasing and spatial density increasing towards the anterior and dorsal sections of the visible frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of white spots, creating a checkerboard-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank. The primary mid-lateral ridge displays a sharp vertical luminance gradient, characterized by high-intensity light reflection on the upward-facing surface and a deep shadow on the downward-facing surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch or irregular indentation is present on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin, approximately one-third of the distance from the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of four distinct, dark elongated silhouettes (commensal organisms) is visible on the ventral side of the shark, positioned directly beneath the pectoral fin.
